title: The Bayesian Learning Rule Beyond KL Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2610.31308v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Bayesian learning rule (BLR) exploits the relation between Bayesian updating and the Kullback-Leibler divergence (KLD) to derive efficient additive updates for exponential family variational posteriors. The KL geometry is powerful but restrictive: combined with posterior families with parameter-dependent support it can lead to undefined objectives. We ask which non-KL geometries preserve the additive BLR computation. Previous works that use $f$-divergences suggest that this is only possible with the KLD. Here, we show that this is not true. We show that additive information-geometric optimization algorithms can be derived for the class of mixed-space Bregman or Fenchel-Young discrepancies. These discrepancies induce generalized maximum-entropy families, dual coordinates, and generalized-BLR canonical gradient updates, recovering the classical BLR. The generalized BLR leads to new algorithms that \textit{cannot} be derived from the KL

translated_title: 超越KL几何的贝叶斯学习规则
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯学习规则（BLR）利用贝叶斯更新与Kullback-Leibler散度（KLD）之间的关系，为指数族变分后验推导出高效的加性更新。KL几何虽然强大但有局限性：当与具有参数相关支撑集的后验族结合时，可能导致目标函数无定义。我们探究哪些非KL几何能够保持加性的BLR计算。先前使用f-散度的研究工作表明，这只有在使用KLD时才可能实现。在本文中，我们证明事实并非如此。我们展示了一类混合空间Bregman散度或Fenchel-Young差异度量，可以据此推导出加性的信息几何优化算法。这些差异度量诱导出广义最大熵族、对偶坐标以及广义BLR规范梯度更新，并恢复了经典的BLR。广义BLR催生出了无法从KL散度推导得到的新算法。
tldr: 本文提出了一类混合空间Bregman/Fenchel-Young差异度量，据此推导出广义贝叶斯学习规则（BLR），突破了KL几何的限制，并能够导出KL散度无法得到的新型加性优化算法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the class of mixed-space Bregman/Fenchel-Young discrepancies to derive a generalized Bayesian learning rule (BLR) beyond KL geometry, enabling new additive optimization algorithms that cannot be derived from the KLD.
